تستحلفن (form X)
# تَسْتَحْلِفْنَ (tastaḥlifna) /tas.taħ.lif.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْلَفَ (istaḥlafa)
# تُسْتَحْلَفْنَ (tustaḥlafna) /tus.taħ.laf.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْلَفَ (istaḥlafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
